pattern: D13 journeys — Picker trigger › D13 journey — (?:open-arrow-enter-reopen-scroll-escape|keyboard-only)$
reason: Opening the Picker — by pointer at step 0 and by ArrowDown at step 1 — leaves focus on the popover dialog where upstream leaves it on the selected option (`role: dialog`, `tabindex: -1` against `role: option`, name `Pro`, `tabindex: 0`), and the dialog focusin/focusout pair upstream emits on the way through is missing. A keyboard user's next arrow press therefore starts from the top of the list instead of from the current choice, and a screen reader announces the popover rather than the selection. Every option stays reachable.

Hovering a ToggleButton or a ToggleButtonGroup item under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` snaps straight to the hover colours: upstream still runs its two 150 ms transitions there (`background-color` and `color`, `cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.4, 1)`) and the port emits no animation at all. Cosmetic only — the same colours are reached, one frame sooner.

pattern: D4 event sequence — Tabs › horizontal-regular · arrow-next-from-selected$
reason: ArrowRight from the selected tab selects and focuses the next tab, but the roving `tabindex` lands one frame late: for two events of the compared log the old tab still reads `tabindex="0"` and the new one `"-1"`, the reverse of upstream. Keyboard navigation works and settles correctly; a tool that reads tab stops inside that frame sees the previous tab as the stop.
